enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: Summons lightning on struck targets during storms.
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.desc: Launches user forward on spear jab attacks.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Launches user in water or rain.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: Creates launching wind on mace smash.
enchantment.nova_structures.aerials_bane: Increases damage dealt to airborne mobs.
enchantment.nova_structures.antidote.des: Poison damage is redirected to the chestplate instead of the wearer.
enchantment.nova_structures.ghasted.desc: Arrows are converted into powerful Ghast fireballs.
enchantment.nova_structures.gravity.desc: Fires arrows that pull nearby entities toward their impact point.
enchantment.nova_structures.hydro_veil.d: Grants the Happy Ghast fire and explosion resistance and improved healing.
enchantment.nova_structures.illagers_ban: Increases damage dealt to Illagers and Witches.
enchantment.nova_structures.multishot.de: Fires three arrows at once from a bow.
enchantment.nova_structures.non_survival: May malfunction and turn into Bane of Arthropods.
enchantment.nova_structures.photosynthes: Repairs the item when exposed to sunlight.
enchantment.nova_structures.piercing.des: Allows arrows to pass through multiple targets.
enchantment.nova_structures.spiteful.des: Deals extra damage at low health and may grant Strength.
enchantment.nova_structures.swift_soar.d: Increases the Happy Ghast's flight speed while the rider is sprinting.
enchantment.nova_structures.traveler.des: Increases sprint speed and allows stepping up full blocks.
enchantment.nova_structures.wax_wings.de: Elytra durability is not consumed while gliding slowly.
enchantment.nova_structures.wither_coate: Applies the Wither effect at the cost of increased durability loss.
